theorem_title: The mechanical envelope for every index at least sixteen
natural_language_statement:
For $s\in\mathbb N$, define $M(0)=0$, $M(s+1)=3M(s)+2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor}$, and $e(s)=\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor+1$.

For every $s\in\mathbb N$ with $s\ge16$,

$$
4M(s)\le s3^s.
$$

This is a bound on the auxiliary mechanical sequence, not an all-start Collatz descent assertion.
